name: MACD Cleaner
summary: This EA trades based on MACD signal line crossovers, entering positions when the MACD histogram crosses above or below the signal line. It aims to clean up false signals by applying additional filtering criteria to the standard MACD crossover strategy. The EA systematically opens and manages trades based on momentum shifts detected by the MACD indicator.
summary_zh: 该EA基于MACD信号线交叉进行交易，当MACD柱状图穿越信号线上方或下方时入场。它通过应用额外的过滤条件来清除标准MACD交叉策略中的虚假信号，旨在提供更清晰的交易信号。EA系统地根据MACD指标检测到的动量变化来开仓和管理交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于MACD指标的经典交叉策略，通过MACD线与信号线的金叉和死叉来判断市场动量方向的变化作为入场条件。入场条件为MACD线上穿信号线时做多，下穿信号线时做空，同时可能包含零轴过滤以区分趋势方向。出场条件通常包括反向交叉信号触发平仓、固定止损止盈或追踪止损。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，可能也支持基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理方面，该EA通过止损设置来控制单笔风险，但具体的风险控制力度取决于参数配置。'Cleaner'的命名暗示该EA可能包含额外的信号过滤机制，如零轴方向过滤、柱状图递增递减确认等，以减少虚假交叉信号导致的亏损交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the classic MACD crossover approach, using the crossover of the MACD line above or below the signal line to detect shifts in market momentum as entry conditions. Entry conditions involve going long when the MACD line crosses above the signal line and going short when it crosses below, potentially with zero-line filtering to confirm trend direction. Exit conditions typically include closing positions on reverse crossover signals, fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, or trailing stop mechanisms. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading and may include dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management relies on stop-loss settings to control per-trade risk, though the effectiveness depends on parameter configuration. The 'Cleaner' designation suggests the EA incorporates additional signal filtering mechanisms such as zero-line direction filtering or histogram confirmation to reduce false crossover signals that lead to losing trades.

parameters.name: ZeroLineFilter
parameters.description: 是否启用零轴方向过滤

pros: MACD是经过长期验证的经典动量指标，策略逻辑透明易懂，便于交易者理解和调优
'Cleaner'过滤机制能减少虚假交叉信号，提高信号质量和胜率
系统化交易消除了情绪干扰，止损设置提供了基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: MACD is a well-established and validated momentum indicator with transparent logic that traders can easily understand and optimize
The 'Cleaner' filtering mechanism reduces false crossover signals, improving signal quality and win rate
Systematic trading eliminates emotional interference, and stop-loss settings provide a basic risk control framework
cons: MACD作为滞后指标，在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
固定止损止盈没有考虑市场波动性变化，在不同行情下可能不适配
缺乏仓位加码和复合信号确认机制，单一指标策略的稳健性有限
cons_en: MACD as a lagging indicator tends to generate frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit do not account for market volatility changes, potentially misaligned across different market conditions
Lacks position scaling and composite signal confirmation, limiting robustness of a single-indicator strategy
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认机制，例如在H4趋势方向过滤H1级别的MACD信号
引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动性自动调整风险参数
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation, such as filtering H1 MACD signals by H4 trend direction
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit that automatically adjusts risk parameters based on market volatility

risk_points: MACD滞后性导致在快速反转行情中入场延迟，可能造成较大滑点亏损
震荡市中频繁交叉信号可能导致连续小幅亏损累积成显著回撤
固定止损未考虑波动性，在高波动时段可能被频繁扫损
risk_points_en: MACD lagging nature causes delayed entry during rapid market reversals, potentially resulting in significant slippage losses
Frequent crossover signals in ranging markets may lead to accumulated consecutive small losses forming significant drawdown
Fixed stop-loss without volatility consideration may be frequently triggered during high-volatility sessions

The EA systematically opens and manages trades based on momentum shifts detected by the MACD indicator.
